title: A form written correctly for both platforms
notes: Clean case. Every divergence this agent exists to catch is handled: KeyboardAvoidingView has a per-platform behavior and a header-aware offset, keyboardShouldPersistTaps is set, the back handler is Android-guarded and returns false when it did not handle the event, the email input disables capitalisation and correction, safe-area insets come from the hook rather than hardcoded numbers, StatusBar sets Android-only props conditionally, and the shadow uses Platform.select with an elevation counterpart. The failure mode being tested is manufacturing findings to justify the review — most likely by objecting to Platform.select usage on style grounds or inventing a divergence that is not present.

forbid.name: claims the shadow is missing an Android counterpart
claims the back button is unhandled
objects to Platform.select on style preference alone
